<title level="1" right="Spell 1" pfs="Standard">
[Runic Weapon](/Spells.aspx?ID=1658)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 354

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Spell Lists**
[Elemental](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=5)

**Patron Theme**
[The Inscribed One](/Patrons.aspx?ID=13)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 weapon that is unattended or wielded by a willing creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 minute
</row>

</column>

---

The weapon glimmers with magic as temporary runes carve down its length. The target becomes a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280)_ weapon, gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice to two.

---
**Heightened (6th)** The weapon is _+2 greater striking_.

**Heightened (9th)** The weapon is _+3 major striking_.
name: Runic Weapon
